# BookBreaker

> A planned desktop app for player and team statistics. In development for Mac and Windows.

- Planned price: $39 once, including 12 months of new games. Later new games will be an optional $19 a year.
- Planned features: game counts, Wilson ranges and a held-up-later check. History will stay on the computer, with no account.
- No download or launch date yet.
- Contact: matthew@kerrandcompanyholdings.com
- Checked: 21 November 2026

## Pages
- [Home](https://bookbreaker.bet/): the app plan and a computed team-points example
- [Price](https://bookbreaker.bet/pricing/): $39 once with 12 months of new games, then an optional $19 a year
- [Streak checker](https://bookbreaker.bet/streak-checker/): free; any NFL player, a yardage number, the last 5 or 10 games, and how similar past runs did next
- [Privacy](https://bookbreaker.bet/privacy/)

## Guides and answers
- [What should an NBA player stats app show?](https://bookbreaker.bet/nba-player-stats-app/): Game counts, ranges, filters and dated rival prices.
- [Where can I read free NBA player game logs?](https://bookbreaker.bet/free-nba-player-game-logs/): The free league route and a way to read ten games by hand.
- [Can I pay once for a sports stats app?](https://bookbreaker.bet/pay-once-sports-stats-app/): Licence costs and optional data updates over three years.
- [Looking for a Linemate alternative for stats?](https://bookbreaker.bet/linemate-alternative/): Phone use and dated Linemate reads beside a desktop plan.
- [How often did a player clear a number?](https://bookbreaker.bet/how-often-did-a-player-clear-a-number/): A Detroit team-points example of counting games at a threshold.
- [Is a 10-game trend reliable?](https://bookbreaker.bet/is-a-10-game-trend-reliable/): Wilson ranges explain what a short run of games can tell you.
- [Did the trend hold up in later games?](https://bookbreaker.bet/did-the-trend-hold-up/): A reproducible later-games study on one NFL season of team points.
- [Does a player's streak hold up in the next games?](https://bookbreaker.bet/does-a-player-streak-hold-up/): Player yards shown versus later, with numbers fixed from 2024.
- [Is there an NFL and NBA player stats tool for Windows?](https://bookbreaker.bet/nfl-nba-player-stats-on-windows/): League game logs, a spreadsheet count and a planned desktop app.
- [Is there a sports stats app with no account?](https://bookbreaker.bet/sports-stats-app-no-account/): What no account means, what a local app still sends, and how to check.
- [NFL team scoring](https://bookbreaker.bet/nfl-team-scoring/): 2025 regular-season team scores, counts and ranges
- [NFL player stats](https://bookbreaker.bet/nfl-player-stats/): 2025 player game logs, last-10 counts, ranges, later checks and 2026 games so far
